question: How can I reduce pink bollworm carry-over in cotton?
answer (as shown): To reduce pink bollworm carry-over in cotton, apply 125 g per application per acre of gossyplure 4% (7, 11 Hexadecadienyl acetate) for mating disruption. Additionally, use Sticka/Delta traps with at least 10 micro litre of gossyplure and place one trap per hectare at 15 cm above the crop canopy, replacing the lure every 15 days.
